description: One checker's acknowledgment of one Fill Threshold Change Log row — a child table on the change rather than a doctype of its own, because an acknowledgment has no existence apart from the change it acknowledges. acknowledge_threshold_update appends a row here; it never edits or removes one, so 'did Ada acknowledge version 3' is answered the same way a year later as the day it happened.

fields.description: The checker acknowledging the threshold in force. list_pending_threshold_acknowledgments reads this column to know who already has.

fields.description: Snapshotted at acknowledgment time, so the row still reads correctly if the Employee is later renamed or leaves.
